messages:
emma: Quick heads-up if youre heading downtown: big puddle at 3rd & Howard that sends a spray across the sidewalk. Almost lost my coffee.

raj: Yikes. N-Judah detour reported near 4th, driver said temporary track flooding. Left my umbrella on the platform, if anyone finds a grey compact please nab it.

transit-bot: SERVICE ALERT: N-JUDAH TEMP REROUTE BETWEEN 4TH & EMBARCADERO DUE TO FLOODING. EXPECT 15-25 MIN DELAYS. https://sfmta.example/alerts

jen: Ferry had a short hold for safety checks but running now. If you're onshore, the shuttle pick-up is on Market now instead of 3rd.

facilities-bot: BUILDING NOTICE: Lobby mats replaced. Wet floor signs out by the east entrance. Maintenance ticket #WET-7721.

omar: Poll: keep standup remote if delays continue? React :house_with_garden: for remote, :office: for in-person.

emma: :house_with_garden: leaning remote. Brought spare socks in the front closet.

raj: Thanks emma. Also someone taped a note to the bike board about a loose cable near rack C  be careful when unlocking.

jen: If anyone needs a ride from SoMa to the office at 11:30, I have room for two. DM me. :oncoming_automobile:

omar: Thanks all. Stay dry and try not to be the one who starts the office-wide towel swap. :towel:
